hub_points_source.name: hub_points_source
hub_points_source.value: "hub_points_entries"."source" in ('manual','attendance') and ("hub_points_entries"."source"='manual' or ("hub_points_entries"."session_id" is not null and "hub_points_entries"."rule_version" is not null and "hub_points_entries"."rule_version">0))

hub_points_amount.name: hub_points_amount
hub_points_amount.value: "hub_points_entries"."amount" between -10000 and 10000 and "hub_points_entries"."amount"<>0 and ("hub_points_entries"."original_id" is not null or "hub_points_entries"."amount">0)

hub_points_reference.name: hub_points_reference
hub_points_reference.value: "hub_points_entries"."session_id" is null or "hub_points_entries"."activity_id" is not null
